title: 第5章 什么？太医院有人想打我林墨屁股？
slug: 快活小御医恭喜皇后有喜了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“臣，遵旨！”林墨顿时松了口气，躬身领命。

看来，这条小命，暂时是保住了。

至于以后，皇帝会不会杀人灭口，一了百了，只能到时走一步看一步了。

“你们先退下！”

刘烈挥了挥手，屏退左右，最后警告了一句。

“林墨，你给朕

“若有第四个人知道……”

“臣明白，请陛下放心！”林墨心领神会，赶紧赌咒发誓。

“臣若是敢胡言乱语，天打雷劈，不得好死！”

当林墨的身影，再次出现在太医院时，已经是深夜时分。

太医院里静悄悄的，只有几盏灯笼，在寒风中摇曳。

值夜的几个小太监看到林墨，一个个眼珠子都快瞪出来了，像是大白天活见鬼。

“林……林太医？你……你没死？”

“你不是被皇上抓走了吗？”

原身性格孤僻，仗着医术高明，清高自傲，不屑与那些钻营之辈为伍，所以在太医院人缘很差。

他被皇帝抓走的消息，早就在太医院嘴里传遍了。

估计都在等着看他的笑话，甚至赌他会被砍头，还是被五马分尸。

林墨懒得理会这些人的惊诧，径直走向自己那间狭小值房。

刚坐下喝了个茶，房门突然被人粗暴推开。

林墨皱眉望去，发现房门前，站着好几个人。

为首的，是一个身穿五品官服，山羊胡，眼神阴鸷的中年人。

正是太医院院判，赵德全，人称赵太医。

此人医术平平，最擅长的就是溜须拍马，是武太后安插在太医院的眼线。

也是林墨，平日里最看不上的人。

赵德全身后，还跟着四个膀大腰圆的粗使太监。

他们手里拿着手臂粗的木制长板，个个脸色不善。

“呦，这不是林太医吗？”

“你终于回来了？”

赵太医皮笑肉不笑地开口了，那双三角眼里，满是幸灾乐祸。

“赵院判，深夜来访，不知有何见教”

林墨双眼微眯，淡然开口。

“哼！林墨，你可知罪？”赵德全脸色一沉，怒声呵斥。

林墨眉头一挑：“赵院判，不知林某所犯何罪？”

“哼，还敢狡辩！”赵太医背着双手，官威十足道。

“你身为太医，无故逗留后宫，深夜才归！”

“此乃宫中大忌！”

"My lord, I obey the order!" Lin Mo suddenly breathed a sigh of relief and bowed to accept the order.

It seems that this little life has been saved for the time being.

As for whether the emperor will kill people and silence them in the future, it will be settled once and for all. We can only wait and see one step at a time.

"You guys stand down first!"

Liu Lie waved his hand, stepped back, and gave a final warning.

"Lin Mo, give me

"If a fourth person knows..."

"I understand, Your Majesty, please rest assured!Lin Mo understood it and hurriedly swore.

"If I dare to talk nonsense, I will be struck by thunder and die!"

When Lin Mo's figure appeared in Tai Hospital again, it was already late at night.

The hospital was quiet, with only a few lanterns swaying in the cold wind.

When the little eunuchs on night duty saw Lin Mo, their eyes nearly popped out, as if they had seen a ghost in broad daylight.

"Lin...Mr. Lin?"You...you're not dead?"

"Weren't you captured by the emperor?"

He was originally a loner, and because of his superb medical skills, he was aloof and arrogant. He disdained the company of those who worked hard, so he was not very popular in Taiyuan Hospital.

The news that he had been captured by the emperor had already spread throughout the imperial hospital.

They were probably waiting to see his jokes, and even bet on whether he would be beheaded or quartered.

Lin Mo didn't bother to pay attention to the surprise of these people and went straight to his small check-in room.

Just as I sat down to drink tea, the door to the room was suddenly pushed open violently.

Lin Mo frowned and looked around and found several people standing in front of the door.

The leader was a middle-aged man wearing a fifth-grade official uniform, a goatee, and sinister eyes.

It was Zhao Dequan, the judge of the Taiyuan Hospital, who was known as the Imperial Physician Zhao.

This man's medical skills were mediocre, and he was best at flattering others. He was Empress Dowager Wu's spy at the Imperial Hospital.

It's also Lin Mo, the person he usually despises the most.

Behind Zhao De's body, there were four thick-armed and round-waisted eunuchs.

They were holding long wooden boards as thick as their arms, and all of them had evil expressions on their faces.

"Hey, isn't this Dr. Lin?"

"You're finally back?"

Doctor Zhao spoke with a smile on his face, his triangular eyes full of gloating.

"Magistrate Zhao, I came to visit late at night. I don't know what I can teach you."

Lin Mo narrowed his eyes slightly and spoke calmly.

"Hmph!Lin Mo, do you know your guilt?"Zhao Dequan's face darkened and he yelled angrily.

Lin Mo raised his eyebrows: "Judge Zhao, I wonder what crime Lin committed?"

"Humph, you still dare to quibble!"Mr. Zhao said with full official authority, his hands behind his back.

"As an imperial physician, you stayed in the harem for no reason and didn't return until late at night!"

"This is a taboo in the palace!"
